name: Iffra Live Chat
author: iffra

sections.description:
Iffra Live Chat connects your WordPress site to the live chat in Iffra CRM. Visitors chat with your team from any page, and the conversations arrive in your Iffra CRM inbox.

  • Connect with a connection key from your Iffra CRM. The key is used once and is not stored on your site.
  • Iffra checks that the plugin is installed on your site before it connects, and the chat only runs on your connected domains.
  • Turn the chat widget off at any time, or hide it on chosen pages.
  • Nothing is loaded on your site and nothing is sent to Iffra until you connect.

You need an Iffra CRM account with a live chat connector to use this plugin.

External services

This plugin connects your site to Iffra CRM, a service provided by Iffra, so it can show the Iffra live chat widget to your visitors. All requests go to https://chat.crm.iffra.com.

  • When you connect: your site sends the connection key you pasted, your site address, your WordPress version and the plugin version. While the connect is in progress, Iffra requests one address on your site to check that the plugin is installed there.
  • On status checks (twice a day, and when you open the plugin’s settings page) and when you disconnect: your site sends its site token, which Iffra issued when you connected.
  • From your visitors’ browsers, once connected: the browser loads the chat script from https://chat.crm.iffra.com. The script sends Iffra the address of each page the visitor views, the referring page, any campaign (UTM) tags in the address, and the visitor’s IP address and browser details. When a visitor uses the chat, it also sends their messages, any details they give such as name, email or phone, and any files or voice notes they send.

Requests from your site also name the plugin version in their user agent. Nothing is loaded or sent before you connect, and nothing is sent when the plugin is deactivated or deleted.

  • Iffra terms of use: https://iffra.com/terms-of-use/
  • Iffra privacy policy: https://iffra.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the iffra-live-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. In your Iffra CRM, open your live chat connector, choose WordPress and generate a connection key.
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings > Iffra Live Chat, paste the key and click Connect.
  4. The chat widget now appears on your site. Use the same screen to turn it off or hide it on chosen pages.
sections.faq:
Where do I get a connection key?

In your Iffra CRM, open the live chat connector and generate a WordPress connection key. The CRM shows the full key only once. Generating a new key replaces the old one, and sites that are already connected stay connected.

Is the connection key stored on my site?

No. The key is held for at most two minutes while the connection is checked, then deleted. After that the plugin uses a site token that Iffra issues for your site.

Connecting fails with “could not reach this site” or “could not confirm the plugin”.

Iffra checks your site from the internet, so the site must be publicly reachable and the WordPress REST API must not be blocked by a security or caching plugin. Sites on localhost connect without this check.

Can I hide the chat on some pages?

Yes. Under Settings > Iffra Live Chat, tick the pages in “Hide on these pages”.

What happens when I disconnect or delete the plugin?

Disconnect tells Iffra to forget your site and removes the connection from WordPress, even if Iffra cannot be reached. Deleting the plugin removes all its data from WordPress and makes no request to Iffra.
